outcome: Umbilical artery blood pH at delivery
Umbilical artery blood base excess (BE) values at delivery
cohort: The study included 1,909 low-risk women who had vaginal deliveries.
finding: The relationship between FHR classifications and umbilical artery blood gas values was clear and changed over the 60 minutes before delivery, with higher FHR classification levels generally correlating with lower blood gas values, and the 5-tier classification being more relevant than the 3-tier.
cross-section timing: FHR patterns were classified from the last 60 minutes before delivery, and outcomes were measured at delivery.
